steps.content:
You should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/6j7hfm/a

Both sellers are listing the **exact same product**:

> Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - graphite
> * 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
> * In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
> * 1-year limited warranty.
> * Same specs: over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones + carry case + USB-C cable + 3.5mm cable

The only differences are price and returns:

**A - Ottervale Audio - $129.00**
* Returns: 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.

**B - Brackmoor Sound - $194.00**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/6j7hfm/b
* Returns: Free 90-day returns.

**Why A:**

1.  **$65 cheaper** - about 33% less - for an identical item, with identical shipping speed, rating, and warranty.
2.  The advantage of B is a better return policy - free vs. you-pay, and 90 days vs. 30 days. But you are paying $65 extra upfront for that. Return shipping on headphones would almost certainly cost much less than $65.

Buy from B only if you think there is a high chance you will return them and you specifically want a long, free return window.

For most buyers, **A from Ottervale Audio is the much better value.**
